description: Blocks LLM-hallucinated packages before they reach code. Checks every package name in Write/Edit/MultiEdit calls against the attester.dev existence oracle (PyPI wheels and npm tarballs, signed answers). Free keyless tier: 25 checks/day per client IP. Blocks only on a confident 'does not exist'; quota exhaustion and offline fail open so the hook can never jam a session. On-disk answer cache keeps routine editing from spending quota. Allowlist import names that differ from registry names (yaml, PIL, cv2) via .attester-allowlist.
